title: GPAS authority hardens before launch; execution remains fail-closed
abstract: This period converted the highest-ranked Paper-020 idea into a default-off, source-faithful local GPAS implementation and then repeatedly tightened the prospective authority before any GPU execution. Setup reconciliation v31 binds train.py SHA-256 0e053f4a530babbe1bc889a983abd382275022d0d3419f29a987c10589c752fa: disabled execution creates no gate, residual operation, or retained optimizer group; enabled execution creates eight shared zero-dimensional layer gates with the paper-frozen schedule-exempt AdamW mapping. A diagnostic-only registry path now permits exactly one implementation/mechanism seed-pair without validation access, endpoint scoring, effect-funnel consumption, adoption, a second pair, or filler. Independent runtime and registration audits found three prospective Paper-020 errors before execution: GPAS learning rate 0.005 had been incorrectly described as current scalar_lr times 0.01, eager residual probes had been conflated with clean compiled timing, and the timing lower-bound bootstrap had not fixed its resampling unit or order-statistic convention. The final six-page ICML-format paper instead freezes 0.005 as an absolute local extrapolation; separates one eager 256-step mediator pair from two clean 256-step role-swapped timing placements; and fixes 28 paired eight-step blocks, 10,000 resamples, seed 19019063, within-placement pairing, geometric aggregation, and zero-based order statistic 499. All six final pages were rerendered and visually inspected. A governed runner is still under adversarial audit, no conforming no-validation worker exists, four typed launch blockers remain, and the reachable remote endpoint currently rejects both available public keys. No GPU phase, validation BPB, comparator change, chart point, or SOTA occurred; historical experiment 501 at 0.927183 remains only the chart origin.
methods: The coordinator compared the local port against the exact official GPAS commit and the frozen Paper-020 mechanism, parameter, optimizer, applicability, mediation, safety, compiler, timing, statistics, and GPU-allocation contracts. Static source tests verify a strict default-off flag, one shared scalar at both residual sites, zero reinitialization after meta materialization, exact optimizer membership and constants, removal of the empty GPAS group when disabled, eager-only probes, and diagnostic tensor hashing. The registry was extended with a narrow implementation-only pilot authority and negative tests showing that ordinary effect experiments cannot request it. An independent registration agent constructed the full prospective observable-intervention-mechanism-hypothesis-idea-experiment chain, checked current R0 rather than using 0.927183 as an arm, and kept scheduler hashes empty. A separate runtime agent and an adversarial chain audit decomposed execution into same-device step-0 replay, one eager mediator pair, and two no-probe compiled role-swapped timing placements; every discovered missing invariant remained a blocker. The audit also froze the exact timing bootstrap before execution: 28 paired contiguous eight-step blocks from steps 33-256, independent per-placement resampling with within-placement arm pairing, 10,000 replicates under random.Random(19019063), geometric placement aggregation, and sorted index 499. Paper 020 was amended only prospectively, compiled with Tectonic, rendered with Poppler, and inspected page by page after each material correction. Validation, strict audit, setup verification, Ruff, 302 maintained local tests with two environment-dependent skips, 35 focused Paper-020 tests, and the read-only prospective preflight passed. The earlier fail-closed source/paper checkpoint was committed as a08ee28; the independently reviewed runner is staged only after its separate no-validation-worker boundary remained explicit. The named Notion workflow fresh-fetched, appended, and fresh-fetched again to verify the earlier corrections.

findings.statement: The default-off GPAS port is structurally inert in the audited local source: no gate parameter or residual operation exists when disabled, and the shared empty-group filter removes the GPAS optimizer group before optimizer construction.
limitations: This is local source and non-CUDA test evidence, not H200 execution evidence.
It does not establish alpha-zero numerical parity, compiler identity, throughput, validation BPB, or efficacy.

findings.statement: The official GPAS mechanism uses one zero-initialized scalar per layer at both residual sites and preserves the hidden-state Jacobian through stop-gradient; the local treatment contract matches that structure while disclosing a different optimizer mapping.
limitations: The OPHIS AdamW group at learning rate 0.005 is a preregistered local extrapolation; the source uses Adam at 0.0005 for all parameters.
The source models are deeper and do not establish that OPHIS exhibits the required baseline variance-growth mechanism.

findings.statement: An implementation-only diagnostic can now receive one-seed GPU allocation without receiving endpoint, adoption, validation-data, or effect-funnel authority, and ordinary effect experiments cannot misuse this path.
limitations: The proposal has not been persisted or promoted to the gated ledger.
Authorization remains impossible until the observable, worker, runner, scheduler hashes, capability gap, hypothesis, and atomic promotion path all pass.

findings.statement: The clean compiler/timing claim must be evaluated in two separate no-probe role-swapped placements rather than inside the eager residual-variance mediator execution.
limitations: This is a corrected prospective design, not a measured compiler or timing result.
The runner and a conforming no-validation worker still require exact committed authority and H200 verification.

negative_results: No GPAS GPU phase launched because the prospective scheduler, executable observable/worker, capability gap, and hypothesis gates remain blocked.
No conforming no-validation worker exists; train.py is inadmissible because its normal terminal path evaluates validation BPB.
The reachable remote SSH endpoint rejected both available public keys, independently preventing a governed GPU census or launch.
No validation BPB, endpoint effect, adoption, control rebind, graph point, or new SOTA was produced.
limitations: The local Mac environment cannot execute the CUDA/FA3 training path, so exact step-0 replay, H200 product identity, compile count, and runtime mediation remain untested.
The historical 0.927183 recipe remains an unqualified chart/provenance anchor after its consumed four-pair transport wave was invalidated by co-tenancy.
Current R0's 0.934930 is only a provisional operational reference and cannot replace a fresh concurrent control.
The runner cannot become launch authority without a separately implemented, hash-bound, no-validation worker and committed detached authority.
decisions: Freeze GPAS learning rate 0.005 as an absolute Paper-020 local constant, not a multiplier of current R0 scalar_lr.
Represent Round 1 as one registered diagnostic seed/pair with exactly three governed pair executions: one eager mediator and two clean compiled role-swapped timing placements.

Freeze the timing lower bound prospectively as 10,000 paired-block percentile-bootstrap replicates with the exact block construction, RNG seed, cross-arm pairing, placement aggregation, and order statistic stated in Paper 020.
Keep scheduler hashes empty, the capability gap open, the hypothesis blocked, and launch authority false until the complete runtime key set exists and passes.
Commit the validated source, paper, registry, tests, setup v31, and fail-closed prospective chain as a08ee28 while excluding the unfinished runner.
Retain 0.927183 only as the historical chart origin and report no new SOTA.
